gameDescriptionHtml:
Warden’s Will is a fast paced movement shooter roguelite, playable solo or in up-to 3 player co-op. Choose your Warden, master unique movements and abilities, and overpower hordes of robots in intense battles. Fly, dash, smash, and turn bullet-hell into bullet-heaven!

The multiverse is trapped in a relentless time loop, and only a Warden can break it. The Warden’s Will is not to just survive, the Warden’s Will is to dominate!

Brace for chaos. Unleash destruction. Dominate the corruption.

Are you ready? Let’s prepare you for the challenge ahead.

Game Features

  • MASTER YOUR WARDEN’S MOVEMENT & ABILITIES – Unique Wardens await, each with their own movement kits and devastating abilities. Fly and rain missiles. Hover and unleash deadly lasers. Dash and slash through enemies. Leap like a rabbit and land like a rhino.
  • WIELD INSANE WEAPONS AND OVERPOWERING AUGMENTS – Lasers, bullets, fireballs—even black-holes. Choose from a wild arsenal of heat based weapons, all with a dual firing system. Mix and match weapons and wardens, and loot hundreds of augments to unleash game-breaking synergies. The multiverse’s power is yours to break!
  • EXPLORE EPIC VERTICAL WORLDS – Fight intense battles in entangled landscapes that test your every move. From scorching lava lands and mysterious deep caves to endless deserts and even space stations.
  • DOMINATE HORDES OF CORRUPTED ROBOTS – Stay alert at all times—the hordes will test your reflexes. Be swift! fly, dodge and dash through the corrupted robots and their fireworks of projectiles.
  • GO SOLO OR TEAM UP – Take on the challenge alone or team up with up-to 2 friends to face the overwhelming corruption and create even more powerful synergies.
  • TURN BULLET HELL INTO BULLET HEAVEN! – Death is inevitable but every failure is a lesson. Each time you fall, you will learn not just how to survive, but how to dominate!
